explication: openGym is a self-hosted workout planner and tracker. The principal workflow is: a user opens the React app, edits a weekly plan, starts a guided session, records sets and body metrics, then persists and synchronizes state through the API. Session construction applies progression rules before the workout begins. The server authenticates with passkeys, stores per-user JSON state, and schedules push reminders. An optional Coach pipeline generates validated plans through configured AI providers; an MCP server exposes local data to desktop LLM clients. Some view-to-library wiring is inferred only from the tree.
